title: On Completeness of $n$-ary Hom-Nambu and Hom-Lie Superalgebras
summary: We introduce and study completeness for multiplicative $n$-ary Hom-Nambu superalgebras. Because an $n$-ary Hom-Nambu bracket is not necessarily totally super-skew-symmetric, we define its center as the intersection of its positional centers. A multiplicative $n$-ary Hom-Nambu superalgebra is complete when its center is trivial, and every $α^{k+1}$-derivation is inner for all $k \geq 0$. We show that this notion reduces to the usual completeness for multiplicative $n$-Hom-Lie superalgebras.
